purpose: Define when Recovery has enough independent, programme-relevant evidence to describe a learner as READY without allowing strong grammar-topic scores or a single global mock mark to hide a critical weakness in a required competence.
principles: The learner's official school recovery programme determines which outcomes and competence axes are active; the default year profile fills gaps but never overrides explicit school requirements.
READY is an evidence decision, not a completion badge: finishing topics or reaching a high topic-average score is not sufficient.
Topic verification is supporting evidence. Every required blocking outcome needs cumulative transfer evidence before it can contribute to READY.
Required competence axes are evaluated separately before an overall readiness score is calculated.
Strong performance in one axis cannot fully compensate for a critical weakness in another required blocking axis or outcome.
Axes that are not required by the learner's programme do not lower readiness because evidence was not collected for them.
The final mock is a required final transfer sample for READY, but its global score cannot erase disaggregated blocking evidence.
Repeated attempts on the same or near-identical form do not count as independent evidence; the latest valid attempt supersedes earlier attempts from that form family.
Recognition-only evidence cannot satisfy an outcome whose Curriculum v2 contract requires controlled production.
SOS mode may reduce study time and available evidence opportunities, but it does not lower READY thresholds or blocking floors.

programme_activation.source_of_truth: required Curriculum v2 outcomes derived from the learner's official school recovery programme
programme_activation.default_profile_fallback: Use the school-year Curriculum v2 profile only where the official programme is incomplete, and mark those requirements as inferred until confirmed.

programme_requirement_rules.default_core: Active by default for the selected school-year profile unless the official programme explicitly excludes or replaces the requirement.
programme_requirement_rules.default_if_assessed: Active only when the school programme or declared recovery-test format assesses the relevant competence or assessment family.
programme_requirement_rules.programme_dependent: Inactive unless explicitly required by the official programme, teacher instructions or declared recovery-test profile.

programme_activation.axis_activation_rule: An axis is active when at least one required outcome on that axis is active for the learner.
programme_activation.inactive_axis_rule: Inactive axes are excluded from evidence-completeness gates, axis scoring and overall readiness weighting.
programme_activation.school_override_limit: The school programme may change required outcomes, assessment modes and axis weights, but once an outcome is active it cannot bypass evidence-integrity, independence or anti-compensation rules.

evidence_eligibility.current_plan_scope: READY evidence must belong to the current Recovery enrollment/plan. Evidence from an older Recovery plan may inform diagnostics but does not satisfy current readiness evidence requirements.
evidence_eligibility.independent_evidence_definition: Evidence is independent when it comes from a distinct assessment form or substantially transformed task and is not an exact or near-duplicate reuse of a teaching, verify, checkpoint or prior mock item.
evidence_eligibility.retry_rule: Multiple attempts on the same assessment form count as one evidence family; the latest valid attempt supersedes earlier attempts from that form family rather than allowing best-score shopping.
evidence_eligibility.unseen_context_rule: At least one cumulative evidence observation used for a required outcome must have unseen_or_mixed_context_flag=true.
evidence_eligibility.production_rule: When the outcome requires controlled production, at least one eligible evidence observation must contain genuine scored production for that outcome.
evidence_eligibility.primary_secondary_rule: Primary-axis evidence counts fully. Secondary-axis evidence may count only when the fragment explicitly declares the outcome and the task genuinely scores that competence rather than merely containing the language feature.

outcome_scoring.aggregation_method: Weighted mean of the latest eligible independent evidence observations for the outcome, using evidence source weights. Do not average repeated attempts from the same form family.
outcome_scoring.interpretation_rule: A numeric outcome score is valid for READY only after the evidence-integrity requirements for that outcome are satisfied.

axis_scoring.aggregation_method: Weighted mean of active required outcome scores on the axis, using blocking_outcome_weight_in_axis for blocking candidates and other_required_outcome_weight_in_axis for other required outcomes.
axis_scoring.critical_rule: An active axis fails its READY gate if any required blocking outcome is below the blocking_outcome_floor, or if more than the permitted share of required blocking outcomes are below the acceptable outcome band.
axis_scoring.empty_axis_rule: An inactive axis has no score and is excluded; an active axis with insufficient eligible evidence is marked insufficient_evidence rather than assigned zero.

overall_scoring.aggregation_method: Weighted mean of active axis scores after all blocking and evidence-completeness gates are evaluated. Default weights are renormalized across active axes.
overall_scoring.school_profile_weight_override: An explicit school-test profile may override default weights and the grammar ceiling when the real recovery assessment is demonstrably grammar-dominant. The override must be stored as programme metadata and the active weights must still sum to 1 after normalization.

evidence_completeness_gates.rule: A learner cannot be READY while evidence completeness is below these gates, even when available scores are high.

final_mock_gate.global_score_role: Summary and additional gate only; it never overrides an axis or blocking-outcome failure.
final_mock_gate.unscorable_global_mark_rule: If the official school profile uses rubrics that do not produce a meaningful global percentage, normalize the scored rubric dimensions to the 0-100 readiness scale while preserving per-axis evidence.

ready_requires_all: no more than 20% of required blocking outcomes on any active axis below 70
100% of required blocking outcomes have valid evidence
at least 85% of all required outcomes have valid evidence
every active blocking axis has cumulative transfer evidence
final mock completed with normalized score >= 70
final mock samples every active blocking axis when feasible within the official school-test profile
ready_decision.near_ready_definition: Evidence completeness is sufficient to make a decision, overall readiness is at least 65, but one or more non-critical READY gates remain unsatisfied.
ready_decision.not_ready_definition: Evidence is sufficient for a decision but overall readiness is below 65, a critical blocking weakness exists, or the final mock shows material failure in a required axis.
ready_decision.insufficient_evidence_definition: The learner has not yet produced enough valid independent programme-relevant evidence to make a defensible READY/NOT READY decision.

allowed: Within an active axis, stronger required outcomes may offset moderately weaker non-critical outcomes through the weighted axis mean, provided the blocking floor and below-acceptable-share gate are respected.
Across active axes, stronger scores may influence the overall weighted readiness number only after every blocking axis has passed its own gate.
prohibited: A high grammar score compensating for a failed required writing, reading, listening or functional-communication blocking axis.
A high global mock score compensating for a required blocking outcome below 65.
Topic completion or topic-verify mastery substituting for missing cumulative transfer evidence.
Repeated retries of the same form inflating evidence count or selecting the best historical attempt instead of the latest valid attempt.
Removing a required axis merely because no content has yet been authored to assess it. Content gaps must surface as insufficient evidence, not as readiness.

status_model.meaning: Non abbiamo ancora abbastanza prove indipendenti e pertinenti al programma per stimare seriamente la preparazione.
Le prove disponibili mostrano una o più debolezze che rendono rischiosa la prova di recupero.
La base è vicina alla soglia, ma resta almeno un requisito concreto da consolidare prima di dichiarare READY.
Le evidenze richieste dal programma superano le soglie minime senza debolezze bloccanti.
Le evidenze sono solide e distribuite sui requisiti attivi, inclusa la simulazione finale.

reporting_contract.learner_facing_rule: Show the overall score only together with the specific axes/outcomes that explain the status. Never present a single percentage as if it were the whole readiness judgment.
reporting_contract.inactive_axis_rule: Clearly mark programme-irrelevant axes as not required rather than displaying them as zero or missing skill.

runtime_migration.legacy_runtime: src/lib/recoveryPlanEngine.js currently calculates readiness as a simple average of topic mastery/diagnostic scores.
activation_preconditions: Curriculum v2 Year 1-3 outcomes merged and cross-year reviewed
pedagogical and technical gap analysis completed
required P0 evidence content and assessment fragments available
runtime evidence storage supports per-outcome and per-axis evidence
shadow comparison performed between legacy readiness and v2 readiness before learner-facing cutover
runtime_migration.cutover_rule: Do not replace the legacy learner-facing readiness calculation until the activation preconditions are met; otherwise missing skill content would be misrepresented as learner failure.
